pages.title: Magical Flora
pages.text: Our early scans indicate that the natural $(l:sim_4/resources/0_surface_level#fungi)Mushroom$() flora of $(item)The Midnight$() have a staggering amount of $(item)Primal Mana$().$(br2)Harnessing this magical energy cannot be done with Altars or Rituals like in the previous simulations though. It's time to get your fingers green with $(item)Botany$().

pages.title: Magical Flora
pages.text: To get started bending the magical will of the local flora, you need to transmute a $(l:sim_4/resources/0_surface_level#ghost_plant)Ghost Plant$().$(br2)You can transmute $(item)Ghost Plants$() by Right-Clicking them with a $(item)Resonating Wand$().

pages.title: Spore Reactor
pages.notes: To harness this $(item)Primal$() mana that is inside the mushrooms. You need to construct a $(item)Spore Reactor$().$(br2)The required materials can be seen in $(l:portal_hub/4_schematica)Schematica$(). Above is a list of some key items required.

pages.title: Midnight Mycelium
pages.description1: To obtain the $(item)Midnight Mycelium$() required to build the $(item)Spore Reactor$() you will have to drop regular $(item)Mycelium$() into $(item)Dark Water$() found in the $(item)Midnight$().

pages.text: After constructing the $(item)Spore Reactor$() in $(item)The Midnight$() (it will only function there), you will be able to start producing $(item)Spore Mana Dust$().$(br2)This refined mana compound can be melted into $(item)Primal Mana$(). This magical liquid can be transposed into a $(item)Mana Tablet$().

The $(item)Mana Tablet$() can hold a great deal of $(item)Primal Mana$(), which can then be stored in $(item)Mana Pools$().$(br2)When dropped into a $(item)Mana Pool$(), the tablet will drain its mana into the mana pool.
$(item)Mana Pools$() can store two full $(item)Mana Tablets$() worth of mana.
Before you can craft $(item)Mana Pools$() or $(item)Mana Tablets$() you will need to create $(item)Living Rock$().$(br2)Craft a $(item)Petal Apothecary$(), and use that to make $(item)Pure Daisys$().
Magical botany is not for the weak of heart, and a great deal of knowledge is required. Read the $(item)Lexica Botanica$() to learn more.$(br2)(The chapter on "Generating Flora" can be ignored)
